summary:
The change passes the saved release channel from ElectronConfig through AppUpdates.getAppInfo() to the renderer. When the channel is staging, SidebarFooter shows a "Staging" label next to the version, with a tooltip. The temp Playwright E2E checks both cases: no label on production, and the label after `release-channel` is set to `staging` and the app restarts, on desktop and in the mobile drawer. The only line reported as uncovered is HostApi.ts:26, an optional property in a type declaration that emits no runtime code. I accept it as non-executable, and I found no defects.

Not approved: 1 changed line(s) are uncovered.
